newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour ahead, but slipping, in opinion poll.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour ahead, but slipping, in opinion poll.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party remains well ahead of the ruling Conservatives but has lost some ground in the past month, according to an opinion poll published on Wednesday.
The first Guardian/ICM poll of 1997 gives Labour a 21-point lead, compared to 26 points in December.
The survey shows Labour on 50 percent, down three from last month, the Conservatives up two on 29 percent and the Liberal Democrats up one on 17 percent.

When voters were asked which party had the best economic policy, 32 percent said Labour, down two points, 29 percent said the Conservatives, up four points, and six percent said the Liberal Democrats, down one point.
ICM interviewed 1,201 adults by telephone on January 3-5.
